feature.title: Clinical Evidence Flood: AI Cardiology Trials, Voice Heart-Failure Prediction, and Device Clearances Reshape MedTech This Week
feature.summary: The week of November 13, 2026 marks a watershed moment for evidence-based medtech, with landmark randomized trial data emerging simultaneously across cardiology, diagnostics, and AI-assisted clinical decision-making. Pivotal readouts from AHA Scientific Sessions 2026 and TCT 2026 have delivered hard outcome numbers—not promises—across AI chest-pain pathways, voice-based heart-failure monitoring, and CT-guided coronary intervention. On the commercialization front, Medicare's nationwide reimbursement for EsoGuard esophageal cancer screening and QUELIMMUNE's 247% revenue surge signal that FDA-cleared diagnostic and therapeutic devices are finally crossing the coverage chasm into broad deployment.

highlights.label: Biggest story
highlights.text: Cordio Medical's DETECT-HF pivotal trial of voice-AI smartphone monitoring predicted over 70% of heart failure events a mean of 24.6 days before clinical presentation in 563 patients, the first blinded prospective validation of its kind.

highlights.label: Key trend
highlights.text: Hard randomized trial evidence—not pilots—is now arriving for AI-guided clinical workflows, with statistically significant outcome gains demonstrated across cardiology imaging, AI-assisted physician reasoning, and autonomous diagnostics.

highlights.label: To watch
highlights.text: EsoGuard's nationwide Medicare reimbursement at $1,938 per test is the leading indicator for how quickly other AI-cleared diagnostics will unlock coverage and commercialize at scale in 2027.

articles.title: Cordio Medical's HearO Voice AI Predicts Heart Failure 24.6 Days Early in Pivotal 563-Patient DETECT-HF Trial
articles.snippet: The DETECT-HF blinded, prospective trial presented at AHA Scientific Sessions 2026 and simultaneously published in JACC: Heart Failure found that the HearO smartphone app correctly predicted more than 70% of heart failure events at an average of 24.6 days before clinical presentation across 563 ambulatory patients at 46 sites. Participants completed 85% of scheduled voice recordings with no device-related adverse events, and Cordio plans to submit the system for FDA clearance ahead of a 2027 US market launch.
articles.result: 70%+ HF events predicted 24.6 days early; 563 patients

articles.title: PARAMOUNT RCT: World's First AI-Driven Plaque-Based Chest Pain Trial Hits Primary Endpoint at AHA 2026
articles.snippet: PARAMOUNT, billed as the world's first randomized trial using AI to drive plaque-based cardiac care, achieved its primary endpoint at AHA 2026 with a win ratio of 2.00 favoring the AI-guided arm over usual care in 523 patients. Lipid-lowering therapy use in the AI-guided arm rose from 31% to 75% following AI-informed testing, with full data expected in early 2027.
articles.result: Win ratio 2.00; lipid therapy uptake rose 31% → 75%

articles.title: HeartFlow P4 Trial: CT-Guided PCI Matches IVUS Outcomes With 27% Shorter Procedure Time — Published in NEJM
articles.snippet: The randomized P4 trial of 1,105 patients, presented as a late-breaker at TCT 2026 and simultaneously published in the New England Journal of Medicine, found CT-guided PCI to be non-inferior to intravascular ultrasound guidance for 12-month target-vessel failure (4.1% vs. 4.6%), while reducing median procedure time by 17 minutes (46 vs. 63 minutes) and contrast volume by approximately 12%. HeartFlow's PCI Navigator altered treatment plans in roughly 70% of cases, most commonly changing stent length.
articles.result: Non-inferior at 12 months; 27% shorter procedure time

articles.title: Abbott Amulet 360 Achieves 96.3% Complete LAA Closure at One Year in VERITAS Pivotal Study
articles.snippet: One-year data from the 458-patient VERITAS pivotal study, presented at TCT 2026 and published in JACC: Cardiovascular Interventions, showed Abbott's next-generation Amulet 360 left atrial appendage occluder achieved complete closure in 96.3% of nonvalvular AFib patients with a 1.8% rate of ischemic stroke or systemic embolism. The device had a 99.3% implantation success rate, clinically relevant device-related thrombosis occurred in only 0.4% of patients, and the device received a CE Mark in August 2026 with US FDA approval pending.
articles.result: 96.3% complete LAA closure; 1.8% stroke rate at 12 months

articles.title: AEYE-DS Autonomous AI Wins 2026 Prix Galien USA Award; Real-World Hospital Deployment Raises Screening Adherence from 29% to 49%
articles.snippet: AEYE-DS, the FDA-cleared autonomous diabetic retinopathy screening AI, won the 2026 Prix Galien USA Best Digital Health Solution award, backed by three prospective multicenter pivotal trials in over 1,200 patients demonstrating 92–93% sensitivity, 89–94% specificity, and greater than 99% imageability. A real-world deployment at UMass Memorial Health showed screening adherence climbed from 29% to 49% in four months while average exam times dropped 75%, and the 2026 ADA Standards of Care explicitly named AEYE-DS as a validated autonomous screening strategy.
articles.result: Adherence 29%→49% in 4 months; 75% reduction in exam time

articles.title: LLM-Assisted Physicians Score Up to 18 Percentage Points Higher in Three-Country Randomized Clinical Trial
articles.snippet: A parallel-group randomized controlled trial involving 249 physicians across Indonesia, Kenya, and the Netherlands found that GPT-4o access significantly improved clinical decision-making scores in all three countries, with the largest gains in Kenya (+18 percentage points, p<0.001), followed by Indonesia (+10.7 points) and the Netherlands (+7.2 points). The results, published November 13, 2026, demonstrate that AI-assisted clinical reasoning can narrow performance gaps across high-, middle-, and low-income health systems.
articles.result: AI improved physician scores 7–18 pts across 3 countries

articles.title: EsoGuard Esophageal Cancer Test Now Fully Reimbursed by Medicare Nationwide; Record Monthly Test Volume Reported
articles.snippet: Lucid Diagnostics announced on November 12–13, 2026 that EsoGuard, its liquid biopsy test for esophageal precancer, is now fully reimbursed by Medicare nationwide at $1,938.01 per test following the first Medicare claim payments in October, with October test volume exceeding 1,800 — a record monthly figure. Cumulative testing has surpassed 50,000 patients, and an 11,991-patient real-world study was published to support broad clinical adoption.
articles.result: Medicare reimbursement live; >1,800 tests in October alone

articles.title: SeaStar Medical QUELIMMUNE Revenue Surges 247% YoY; Registry Shows Higher Survival in Pediatric AKI Patients
articles.snippet: SeaStar Medical reported Q3 2026 net revenue of $635,000 for QUELIMMUNE (SCD-PED), a 247% year-over-year increase driven by accelerating hospital adoption of the only FDA-approved therapy for pediatric sepsis-associated acute kidney injury. SAVE Registry data from 50 critically ill pediatric patients presented at ASN Kidney Week 2026 showed statistically significant higher survival rates at 60 and 90 days and at hospital discharge versus comparator cohorts, with no device-related adverse events.
articles.result: 247% revenue YoY growth; higher survival vs. comparators

articles.title: PlaqueTec BIOPATTERN Intracoronary Liquid Biopsy Trial Passes 100 Patients, Expands to 8 NHS Cardiac Centers
articles.snippet: PlaqueTec's BIOPATTERN clinical trial, investigating intracoronary liquid biopsy to identify biological drivers of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, has enrolled its 100th patient and expanded to eight NHS specialist cardiac centers across England. The trial is run by Papworth Trials Unit Collaboration and overseen by a steering committee chaired by Professor Peter Libby of Harvard Medical School.
articles.result: 100 patients enrolled; 8 NHS cardiac centers now active

articles.title: Bechtel Medical Wins First-Ever FDA 510(k) Clearance for Combined Negative Pressure + Topical Oxygen Wound System
articles.snippet: Bechtel Medical's Wound VOX received 510(k) clearance from the FDA on November 10, 2026, becoming the first device to combine negative pressure wound therapy and topical oxygen therapy in a single cleared platform, with three therapy modes targeting hard-to-heal wounds. The company plans a limited commercial rollout in December 2026, with the system designed to reduce operational complexity and potentially improve wound closure rates, infection risk, and tissue quality.

articles.title: FDA Finalizes Class II Status for AI Pap Slide Imaging System and Dementia-Risk Prognostic Software, Opening 510(k) Route
articles.snippet: The FDA published final orders on November 4–6, 2026 classifying an AI-powered digital cervical cytology slide imaging system and mild cognitive impairment prognostic assessment software into Class II, completing the De Novo pathway transition and opening the 510(k) clearance route for competing products in both categories. These classifications, alongside a wearable vibration device for orthopedic use, signal the FDA's accelerating standardization of AI-enabled diagnostic software as established device types.
articles.result: AI Pap slide tool and dementia software granted Class II status

articles.title: Milestone Scientific CompuFlo Medical Segment Revenue Grows 136% YoY as Physician Partnerships Expand
articles.snippet: Milestone Scientific reported that its medical segment — anchored by the CompuFlo computer-controlled fluid delivery system for epidural and joint injection procedures — grew revenue 136% year-over-year in Q3 2026, driven by expansion of physician partnerships and a doubling of online commercial demonstrations. The company reaffirmed its 2026 full-year revenue outlook of $9.8–$10.2 million and projects approaching profitability in Q4 2026.
articles.result: Medical segment revenue +136% YoY; full-year guidance $9.8–10.2M
